command: set -euo pipefail; export RICCON_TEST_SERVICES=external RICCON_TEST_SERVICES_NAMESPACE=m19v21; export ROOT="${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/m21-verifier-evidence"; rm -rf "$ROOT"; mkdir -p "$ROOT"; node scripts/test-services.mjs reset --namespace m19v21 > "$ROOT/reset.log"; for i in $(seq 1 10); do ./mvnw -q -T1C -pl apps/worker -am test -Dtest=ModelFailoverIntegrationTest -Dsurefire.failIfNoSpecifiedTests=false > "$ROOT/targeted-$i.log" 2>&1; grep -q 'tests="17" errors="0" skipped="0" failures="0"' apps/worker/target/surefire-reports/TEST-com.riccon.worker.model.ModelFailoverIntegrationTest.xml; echo "targeted_run=$i tests=17 failures=0 errors=0 skipped=0"; done; rm -rf apps/*/target/surefire-reports platform/*/target/surefire-reports; ./mvnw -q -T1C -pl apps/worker -am test > "$ROOT/worker-full.log" 2>&1; node scripts/test-timings.mjs --out-dir "$ROOT/test-timings" > "$ROOT/test-timings.out"; grep -q "apps/worker: tests=356 failures=0 errors=0 skipped=0" "$ROOT/test-timings.out"; grep "apps/worker: tests=" "$ROOT/test-timings.out"; ./mvnw -q spotless:check; git diff --check; echo "verifier-evidence-ok targeted=10x17 worker_full=356/0/0/0 spotless=ok diff-check=ok"
note: M21 独立验证：external namespace=m19v21；ModelFailoverIntegrationTest 连续 10 次，每次 17/0/0/0；Worker 全量 356 用例 0 failure/error/skip；spotless:check 与 git diff --check 通过。验证 holdAfterFirstContent/releaseContent 闸门与 afterFirstResponse 钩子确实把错误帧推迟到首段内容被消费后。
